purpose: Freeze the independent synthetic confirmation seed universe and final candidate model before any confirmation outcome is computed. Strong-comparator numerical promotion gates will be added from development evidence before execution authorization.
primary_metric: mean Bernoulli log loss over untouched target rows within regime, averaged equally across confirmation seeds
secondary_metrics: worst-seed log-loss harm relative to environmental support

candidate_model.name: fixed probability-gate plus cross-fitted-stack EOG structural ensemble
candidate_model.probability_gate: training-fitted lambda in D = H * ((1-lambda) + lambda*M_EOG)
candidate_model.stack: deterministic L2 logistic f(H, M_EOG, H*M_EOG) fitted on inner out-of-fold H/M; nonstructural stack collapses to H
candidate_model.unlabelled_landscape_nodes: may act as neutral intermediate nodes but never as sources

pending_before_execution: freeze regime-specific strong-comparator noninferiority/superiority gates from the already-open development evidence
freeze exact confirmation runner source and expected contract fingerprint
scientific_boundary: Synthetic confirmation evaluates predictive support under declared source-conditioned generators. It does not establish realized movement, colonisation probability, latent occupancy, or universal empirical superiority over dynamic/mechanistic/connectivity models.
